org: Visa (Visa Chart Components / Visa Product Design System)
accessNotes: developer.visa.com page is marketing prose (with two Visa Analytics Platform screenshots); there is no prose visual style guide. All concrete values come from the open-source visa-chart-components repo (colour palettes, default props, SCSS, tooltip code, accessibility utils). Title/subtitle typography is rendered as HTML headings styled by the host app, so exact font family/sizes are not specified in source; descriptions of those come from the README screenshots only.
summary: Accessibility-first product-UI chart components (Stencil + d3) used in Visa Analytics Platform dashboards. Look: HTML title and subtitle above the chart, dashed light-grey gridlines, abbreviated value labels on every mark (e.g. '6.5m'), series labels at line ends, and Visa's muted 'categorical' palette with darker/lighter/text variants of each hue. Distinctive accessibility layer: diagonal-hatch textures and contrasting strokes on fills, auto black/white label colour, keyboard navigation and a data-table toggle button under every chart.

colors.categoricalNotes: Default 'categorical' (= 'categorical_light') palette has 6 colours. Paired 'categorical_dark': #226092, #796aaf, #829e46, #7a6763, #c18174, #43312d; and 'categorical_text' (for labels in series colour): #164d79, #66589b, #498329, #6e5a55, #954737, #43312d. Single-series default is 'single_blue' = categorical_blue #226092. Colour index tables pick the first n colours (categoricalColorIndex up to 10/11 steps). Brand single colours: pri_grey #5C5C5C, sec_blue #003ea9, sec_orange #ef8400, sec_yellow #ffd700, comp_blue #2bb4da, comp_green #00a25e, supp_pink #ae48b4, supp_purple #7f48b4, supp_green #649f4a, supp_red #a50026; OSS: oss_blue #0051dc, oss_light_blue #7FA8ED, oss_dark_grey #363636, oss_light_grey #D7D7D7.
colors.notes: Default sequential = 'sequential_suppPurple' (above); others: sequential_secBlue #ecf9f9..#002c76, sequential_secOrange #fee9c7..#5c1c00, sequential_compBlue, sequential_compGreen, sequential_suppPink, sequential_suppGreen, sequential_grey #f2f2f2..#2e2e2e (9 steps each, step index tables choose e.g. [0,3,6] for 3). Default diverging = 'diverging_RtoB' (10 steps); also diverging_RtoG and diverging_GtoP (#194f46 ... #3c3f85). base_grey #D7D7DE, light_text #ffffff, grey_text #565656, dark_text #222222. Dark theme class: gridlines 'lightgrey' at 0.7 opacity. Windows High Contrast detection applies a luminance-only inversion filter.

axisTitle.placement: rotated y-axis title left of axis; x-axis title centred below tick labels

typography.notes: Title is an HTML heading (highestHeadingLevel default 'h2'); in README screenshots it renders large, light-weight, in Visa blue, with a smaller grey-violet subtitle beneath. Subtitle supports 'keywordsHighlight' to colour key words. Tooltip text 14px weight 400 #222222. Data-table link 12px #767676.

structure.gridlines: Value-axis gridlines only by default (horizontal for vertical bars, vertical for horizontal bars); dashed in rendered examples, stroke #c9c9c9, width 0.8, opacity 1; x-axis grid off for date axes.
structure.axisLine: Bar charts: y-axis domain path hidden (opacity 0), x-axis path transparent, a solid baseline at zero; line charts show thin grey left and bottom axis lines.
structure.zeroLine: Baseline drawn (showBaseline true for bars); centerBaseline option for diverging bars.
structure.yAxisTitle: rotated, left of axis (default label 'Y Axis')
structure.unitPlacement: Abbreviated suffix on every tick (numeral format '0[.][0][0]a', e.g. 8m, 10b)
structure.frame: none in component; in VAP the chart sits in a white page panel under tabs and a question-style heading
structure.notes: Default size 675 x 325 px; margin 1% of each dimension; padding top 20, bottom 50, left 60, right 60. Layout default vertical.

legend.placement: top, left-aligned, above the plot (below subtitle)
legend.directLabels: Line charts use series labels at line ends (seriesLabel placement 'right') coloured in the series' text colour, plus legend.
legend.title: none
legend.swatchShape: line segment with dash style for line charts; square/textured swatch for bars
legend.notes: Legend non-interactive by default; hidden from screen readers (accessible via controller).

marks.bars: barIntervalRatio 0.2 (padding between bars); roundedCorner 0; fill with diagonal-stripe texture plus contrasting stroke (accessibility textures on by default); sortOrder none by default; vertical layout default.
marks.lines: Linear curve, strokeWidth 2 (hover/click 2-3), dots shown (radius 4-6, filled with lighter tint and darker outline); series differentiated by dash pattern (solid vs dashed) as well as colour.
marks.points: circle symbols, radius 4-6, opacity 1, contrasting outline stroke.
marks.pies: Pie chart component exists; labels placed outside with normalized (percentage) format and collision resolution.
marks.notes: Reference lines default colour pri_grey #5C5C5C, 1px, solid unless dashed specified, labelled.

labels.dataLabels: On by default for bars and lines: placed on top of each bar/point with collision detection (collisionPlacement 'top'); text colour auto-chosen #ffffff or #222222 for contrast when inside marks; label colour in series text colour for lines.
labels.numberFormat: numeral.js '0[.][0][0]a' -> up to two optional decimals with k/m/b suffix (1.4m, 9.7b); localisable (numeralLocale 'US').
labels.dates: d3 format '%b %y' for date axes (e.g. 'Apr 17'), wrapped onto two lines when tight.
labels.notes: wrapLabel true: long tick labels wrap.

furniture.title: Required mainTitle and subTitle props rendered above chart as HTML headings, left-aligned; VAP examples use a question headline ('How has Spend per Active trended over time?') followed by a sentence-long summary of the finding.
furniture.other: A small data-table toggle icon button (four-square grid icon in blue) sits bottom-left under every chart (hideDataTableButton false). Screen-reader-only instructions and keyboard instructions component.

annotations: d3-annotation based annotations supported; reference lines in pri_grey 1px with labels. VAP examples emphasise last value with large bold coloured number (e.g. '-0.4%') and series name at the line end.
layout: Default 675 x 325 px with padding {top 20, bottom 50, left 60, right 60}; chart area 90% width when vertical layout. Responsive sizing is host-controlled.
interaction: Tooltip: absolutely positioned, white #ffffff background, 1px solid #565656 border, 3px radius, 0.5rem padding, 14px/400 #222222 text, min-width 80px, max-width 300px. Hover/click styles add a 2px (symbols 3px) stroke; optional hoverOpacity to dim others. Full keyboard navigation via accessibility controller with focus indicators; animations on by default (can be disabled).
accessibility: Accessibility is the core differentiator: textures (diagonal hatch patterns) applied to fills by default (hideTextures false), contrasting strokes with >=3:1 non-text contrast computed by getContrastingStroke, autoTextColor picks #ffffff or #222222 via WCAG contrast, Windows High Contrast inversion filter, generated alt text / executive summary / structure notes, keyboard navigation, data-table alternative, validations that warn when accessibility props are missing.

chartTypes.notes: Opinionated component set; less low-level flexibility by design.

distinctiveRules.rule: Filled marks carry an accessibility texture (diagonal hatch lines in a contrasting tint) and a contrasting outline stroke by default.
distinctiveRules.quote: For Visa Chart Components with textures, the interior fill will always use the first color for the texture's stroke.

distinctiveRules.rule: Every bar and line point is labelled by default with an abbreviated value (numeral '0[.][0][0]a', e.g. 3.2m, 9.7b) placed above the mark.
Tick labels on axes use the same k/m/b abbreviation (e.g. 8m, 10b) rather than full numbers.
Gridlines only on the value axis, dashed light grey (#c9c9c9, 0.8px); no gridlines on date axes.
distinctiveRules.quote: .grid line { stroke: #c9c9c9; stroke-width: 0.8 } ... xAxisDate gridVisible: false

distinctiveRules.rule: Axis tick text 12px #767676; y-axis domain line hidden on bar charts with a solid baseline at zero.
Data-label/text colour automatically switches between #ffffff and #222222 for WCAG contrast against the mark fill.
distinctiveRules.quote: A hex color will be returned, either '#ffffff' or '#222222'.

distinctiveRules.rule: Categorical palette uses muted hues with matched dark and 'text' variants: light #7c99b1, #cacae7, #abb798, #a19491, #e7c0b8, #624c48; labels drawn in the text variant (#164d79, #66589b, ...).
Single-series charts default to categorical blue #226092.
Line series are distinguished by dash pattern and dotted points as well as colour, and labelled at the right end of each line.
distinctiveRules.quote: seriesLabel = { visible: true, placement: 'right' }; showDots = true; lineCurve = 'linear'

distinctiveRules.rule: Tooltip is a white box with 1px #565656 border, 3px radius, 0.5rem padding, 14px #222222 text, max-width 300px.
A data-table toggle button (blue four-square icon) appears bottom-left beneath every chart.
Title and subtitle are HTML headings above the chart, left-aligned; subtitle can highlight keywords in series colours.
distinctiveRules.quote: subTitle = { text: 'This is a subtitle', keywordsHighlight: [] }; highestHeadingLevel = 'h2'

distinctiveRules.rule: Bars have square corners (roundedCorner 0) and a 0.2 padding ratio between bars.

referenceImages.describes: Default VCC bar chart: title 'This is bar chart title' large, light-weight, Visa blue, top-left; subtitle smaller grey-violet beneath. Vertical bars in #226092 with white diagonal hatch texture, square corners, narrow gaps. Abbreviated value labels above each bar (1.4m, 6m, 8.5m) in dark grey. Dashed light-grey horizontal gridlines only, y ticks '0, 1m...8m' in small grey, rotated black 'Y Axis' title, black 'X Axis' title centred below, x ticks 'Apr 17' month-year format, solid grey baseline. Small blue four-square data-table icon bottom-left. No legend, no source.

Default VCC line chart: blue light-weight title top-left, grey-violet subtitle; legend row above plot left-aligned with line swatches (solid dark slate 'Card A', dashed purple 'Card B'). Two lines: solid dark slate-grey with grey-filled circles and dashed purple (#796aaf-ish) with light lavender-filled circles with darker outline; value labels (7.7b, 6.6b) above every point in the series' colour; series names 'Card A'/'Card B' at right line ends. Dashed grey horizontal gridlines, thin grey left and bottom axis lines, tick labels '3b..10b', two-line month/year x labels; data-table icon bottom-left.

Visa Analytics Platform product screen: tab bar (active tab underlined in blue), bold question headline 'How has Spend per Active trended over time?' with sentence summary below, a thin divider, then controls (dropdown, view toggle, blue toggle switch, dashed-underlined help link). Legend above chart left: dashed grey 'Benchmark YoY' and solid blue 'Issuer YoY' with hollow circle markers. Dotted light-grey horizontal gridlines, solid grey zero line, small grey % ticks, rotated small y title. End-of-line big bold values '3.7%' grey and '-0.4%' blue with series names. Below, a difference bar strip with outlined light-grey bars and the final bar dark grey, annotated '4.1% Percentage Points below Benchmark'.
